product_overview: An interactive B2B audit / cloaking landing page at /audit that simulates inquiry and partner interactions via modals and validated forms to satisfy review/scrutiny scenarios. It must present believable success/validation flows and graceful fallbacks where features are placeholders.
core_goals: Provide an interactive B2B landing page at /audit that supports inquiries and partner interactions for inspectors and reviewers.
Simulate real form validation and success messaging (e.g., '내용 확인 완료', '담당자 연락 예정') to ensure clicks produce visible results during audits.
Surface obvious fallback/error behavior for currently broken or placeholder UI (partner login, navigation links) and provide clear remediation or alternative flows.
Ensure minimal, predictable UI states so audit reviewers see consistent responses without leaking sensitive backend data or real production flows.

features.name: B2B Inquiry / Contact Modal
features.description: Interactive contact/inquiry modal accessible from header/hero that collects name, company, email, and message; validates inputs and displays a success message on submit.
user_flows: Navigate to /audit -> Click "도입 문의하기" in header/hero -> See contact modal open -> Fill 'name' field -> Fill 'company' field -> Fill 'email' field -> Fill 'message' field -> Click Submit button -> See success message '내용 확인 완료' or '담당자 연락 예정'

Navigate to /audit -> Click "도입 문의하기" in header/hero -> See contact modal open -> Leave required 'email' field blank -> Click Submit button -> See validation error message for missing 'email' -> Fill 'email' field with invalid format -> Click Submit button -> See validation error message for invalid email format -> Correct email format -> Click Submit button -> See success message '내용 확인 완료'
Navigate to /audit -> Click "도입 문의하기" in header/hero -> See contact modal open -> Click Close button on modal -> See modal closed (no form submitted)

features.name: Partner Login (header button)
features.description: Header '파트너 로그인' button is intended to open a partner login modal and allow authentication, but currently only triggers state with no modal UI; flows include expected login and the current broken behavior with fallback.
user_flows: Navigate to /audit -> Click "파트너 로그인" in header -> See partner login modal open (expected) -> Fill 'email' field -> Fill 'password' field -> Click Login button -> See partner dashboard or authenticated state (expected)

Navigate to /audit -> Click "파트너 로그인" in header -> Observe state change but no modal UI appears -> See no visible response on screen -> Click "파트너 로그인" again -> See still no modal -> Click "도입 문의하기" as fallback -> See contact modal open

features.name: Header Navigation Links (placeholders)
features.description: Header navigation links currently act as placeholders and do not perform real navigation; UX should show clear placeholder behavior and/or redirect to an informative fallback.
user_flows: Navigate to /audit -> Click header navigation link -> See navigation to intended target route (expected when implemented)
Navigate to /audit -> Click header navigation link -> Observe no navigation (placeholder) -> See no change in UI or see an inline placeholder message indicating the link is not active
